title: Pima Air & Space Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: General admission covers the main hangars, three World War II Hangers, the Dorothy Finley Aerospace Gallery, the Arizona Aviation Hall of Fame and so much more! Unless you are booking a private tour or a group of 10+, we are not selling advance tickets, please purchase your admission when you arrive for your visit. 2-day tickets and combo tickets do not have to be used on consecutive days, but must be redeemed within 30 days of purchase. services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Pima Air and Space Museum welcomes groups of 10 or more to the museum. If your group is less than 10 you do not need to book in advance, you will just pay at the door. Groups of 10-49 people do have the option to book online but are not required. Groups of 50 or more are required to book in advance to receive the group discount. Please note if you are looking to book a school field trip or youth group visit, please visit our Education pages for the correct pricing. All group bookings will need to be booked a minimum of 48 hours prior to their visit. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Discover the exciting world of aviation, space exploration, engineering, and history with a week-long Summer Camp. Camps are offered throughout the summer with different themes each week. Choose your favorite or attend all four weeks! Each week, campers will get to go to three museums: Pima Air and Space Museum, Tucson Military Vehicle Museum, and the Titan Missile Museum. Campers will be divided into two age groups: 6-9 and 10-12. Campers will experiment with the science of flight, rocket-building, and the fascinating world of tanks and other vehicles.
